content_zh:
大乾王朝，将军府内几位十几岁少年聚在一起。
“你们听说了没？无敌哥又外出狩猎了”一位青衣的少年挑起了话题，看着面前其他小伙伴一脸懵的望着他内心的得意已经浮现在了脸上。
“真的假的？无敌哥上周不是才刚回来吗？这么短的时间又出去了，无平你不要乱说”这时一个白衣少年站出来反驳了一句，脸上满是怀疑之色。
杨无平见有人提出了质疑立马分享起信息的源头“杨宝你懂什么？这是我爹亲口说的，再说我要是有无敌哥那种实力别说一周我回家三天就要出去而且听说无敌哥这次出去好像得到了惊云枪的认可”
杨宝一脸羡慕和震惊“惊云枪啊？杨家传世神枪已经被无敌哥拿下了无敌哥太厉害了”
“我要是也能像无敌哥这么厉害就好了”突然间一人的声音让所有人安静下来，然后不知谁噗嗤笑了一声全场的少年都笑了。
“杨修，谁不知道你是杨家新一代枪道天赋最差的，我们这群人里面你年龄最大却是领悟杨家枪谱领悟的最少的”杨无平大笑的说道。
杨修通红气愤道“你们懂什么？我这叫大器晚成，说不定我比无敌哥更早凝聚灵宝呢？”
杨宝走到杨修身前用手摸了摸杨修额头然后道“这也没发烧啊？怎么说起了胡话？灵宝这种东西都说的出来？谁不知道整个大乾王朝只有天才的九王爷之子郑元淳以刀凝聚灵宝以身证道，而下一个就是无敌哥，说不定等无敌哥凝聚灵宝的时候你连杨家枪谱还没学会呢？哈哈哈哈哈哈。”
“你们太过分了！”杨修气冲冲的跑回了自家别院，一进房门就看到母亲一脸柔和的在摆弄着针线活，正当他想走到母亲身边时，院外父亲火急火燎的进来，看到杨修在并没有说话，冲妻子使了个眼色，眼中带着哀伤。
“阿爹你回来了啊！杨宝他们说我枪道天赋差”杨修满脸红的述说小伙伴的恶行
母亲起身温柔的摸了摸杨修的脑袋“修儿乖，修儿在娘这里是最厉害的”
杨修的心情慢慢平复下来，其实他也知道自己的枪道天赋很差，但是他坚信努力就有结果的，阿爹和阿娘从来没有在这方面怪过他用他们的话来讲“你厉不厉害不重要，在阿娘和阿爹这里你每天开开心心的就很好”
“咳！好了等会我和你阿娘要去参加家族会议”这时站在一旁的阿爹杨云开口了。
叶子清蹲下身子捏捏杨修的脸开口道：“老样子捉迷藏等阿爹阿娘回来找不到你，认输的时候你出来就给你奖励”
“好呀好呀！阿爹阿娘你们快去吧！”杨修很开心的说，他从小就爱玩这个游戏不为别的因为每次他都能获得爹娘的奖励，凭借这个在小伙伴里吹嘘过几次，每次他们都投来羡慕的目光，这让他十分得意。
“等会藏起来之前记得喝掉桌上的茶水喔！”叶子清又摸了一把杨修的头就和杨云走了。
杨修看爹娘走了之后上了个厕所，然后把茶水一饮而尽跑到床下伸手推了一下完美的石墙出现了一道暗格，他爬了进去，然后满是得意的轻拍内部石壁暗格又复原了，这是阿爹平时藏私房钱的地方他无意间看到的，第一次进来的时候就觉得很大用来藏私房钱是不是有点多余了但是这次进来好像发现了食物他有点疑惑但是没多想，心里想着这次要什么奖励然后眼皮开始沉重，他扛不住睡意失去了意识。
将军府大厅，一队士兵冲入其中，一身穿银色重甲的人满脸戏谑的看着坐在大厅中央的杨天成，“杨将军九王爷让我问话，你们杨家降还是不降？”
“白樊别废话了，本就是党派之争杨家始终追随的都是陛下，你们才是乱臣贼子，就算我说了杨家投降你在九王爷那边也会说杨家誓死不降的吧！”杨天成一脸讥讽的看着白樊，白家和杨家本就是对立面现在白家势大想借这个由头彻底铲除掉杨家九王爷也是管不了的，因为白家支持的是九王爷，而杨家始终都是皇帝派系。

白樊大笑转身向外走去“杨家誓死不降，灭满门。”
话落门外的士兵冲了进来。
右侧一中年人看着杨天成忍不住喊了句“家主”看样子打算反抗。
杨天成摆摆手“算了，既然结局没办法改变，反抗就没必要徒增伤亡了，我杨家上下满门忠烈”说完闭上了眼睛，三秒后嘴角溢出鲜血，自震断静脉而死，众人看到家主如此也说了句“我杨家上下满门忠烈”同家主一起去了。
士兵们本来以为是一场恶战看到大厅内部情景纷纷鞠了一躬然后离去搜寻其他院子活口。

content_en:
During the Daqian Dynasty, several teenage boys gathered together in the General's Mansion.
"Have you heard? Invincible Brother is out hunting again." A young man in Tsing Yi raised the topic, looking at the other friends in front of him looking at him in confusion, the pride in his heart had already appeared on his face.
"Really or not? Didn't Brother Wuwei just come back last week? He went out again in such a short time, Wuping, don't talk nonsense." At this time, a young man in white stood up and retorted, with a look of suspicion on his face.
Seeing someone raise a question, Yang Wuping immediately shared the source of the information, "Yang Bao, what do you know? This is what my father said personally. Besides, if I had the strength of Brother Invincible, let alone I go out three days a week after returning home. And I heard that Brother Invincible seems to have been approved by the Jingyun Gun for going out this time."
Yang Bao looked envious and shocked, "Shocking Cloud Spear? The Yang family's handed down divine spear has been captured by Brother Invincible. Brother Invincible is so powerful."
"It would be great if I could be as powerful as Brother Invincible." Suddenly a voice made everyone quiet, and then someone burst out laughing and all the young people in the room laughed.
"Yang Xiu, who doesn't know that you are the least talented in the Yang family's new generation of gun skills? Among our group of people, you are the oldest but the least knowledgeable about the Yang family's gun skills." Yang Wuping said with a laugh.
Yang Xiu blushed and said angrily, "What do you know? I'm called a late bloomer. Maybe I can condense the spiritual treasures earlier than Brother Invincible?"
Yang Bao walked up to Yang Xiu and touched Yang Xiu's forehead with his hand and said, "You don't even have a fever? Why are you talking nonsense? You can talk about things like Lingbao? Who doesn't know that in the entire Daqian Dynasty, only the genius son of the Ninth Prince Zheng Yuanchun can condense the Lingbao with a knife to prove the Tao, and the next one is Brother Invincible. Maybe by the time Brother Invincible condenses the Lingbao, you haven't even learned the Yang family's gun music? Hahahahahaha."
"You're going too far!" Yang Xiu angrily ran back to his villa. As soon as he entered the door, he saw his mother doing needlework with a gentle face. Just when he was about to go to his mother, his father came in hurriedly. Seeing that Yang Xiuzai didn't speak, he winked at his wife with sadness in his eyes.
"Dad, you're back! Yang Bao and the others said that I have poor talent in shooting." Yang Xiu blushed and recounted the evil deeds of his friends.
Mother stood up and touched Yang Xiu's head gently, "Xiu'er, be good, Xiu'er is the most powerful here."
Yang Xiu's mood slowly calmed down. In fact, he also knew that his talent in shooting was very poor, but he firmly believed that hard work would bring results. Dad and Aniang had never blamed him in this regard. In their words, "It doesn't matter whether you are good or not. As long as you are happy every day here with Aniang and Aniang, it's good."
"Ahem! Okay, your mother and I are going to attend a family meeting later." At this time, father Yang Yun, who was standing aside, spoke.
Ye Ziqing knelt down and pinched Yang Xiu's face and said: "It's the same as the old hide-and-seek waiting for my father and mother to come back and I can't find you. When I give in, I'll give you a reward when you come out."
"Okay, okay! Dad and Mom, go quickly!" Yang Xiu said happily. He has loved playing this game since he was a child because he can get rewards from his parents every time. He has boasted among his friends several times with this, and every time they cast envious glances, which makes him very proud.
"Remember to drink the tea on the table before you hide it later!" Ye Ziqing touched Yang Xiu's head again and left with Yang Yun.
Yang Xiu saw his parents leaving and went to the toilet. He then drank the tea and ran under the bed. He stretched out his hand and pushed the perfect stone wall. A hidden grid appeared. He climbed in, and then patted the inner stone wall with pride. The hidden grid was restored. This was the place where his father usually hid private money. He accidentally saw it. When he first came in, he felt that it was a bit redundant to hide private money. But this time he seemed to find food. He was a little confused but didn't think much about it. He thought about what reward he wanted this time and opened his eyes.It started to feel heavy, and he couldn't hold back his sleep and lost consciousness.
In the lobby of the General's Mansion, a group of soldiers rushed into it. A man wearing silver heavy armor looked at Yang Tiancheng who was sitting in the center of the hall with a joking face, "General Yang, the Ninth Prince asked me to ask, will the Yang family surrender or not?"
"Bai Fan, stop talking nonsense. This is a partisan dispute. The Yang family has always followed His Majesty. You are the rebellious officials and traitors. Even if I say that the Yang family surrenders, you will still say to the Ninth Prince that the Yang family will not surrender until death!" Yang Tiancheng said with a mocking look on his face. Looking at Bai Fan sarcastically, the Bai family and the Yang family were originally on opposite sides. Now that the Bai family is so powerful, it cannot be used to completely eradicate the Ninth Prince of the Yang family, because the Bai family supports the Ninth Prince, and the Yang family has always been the emperor's faction.
Bai Fan laughed and turned around and walked out, "The Yang family will not surrender until they die, and they will be wiped out."
After saying that, the soldiers outside the door rushed in.
A middle-aged man on the right looked at Yang Tiancheng and couldn't help shouting "Master", apparently planning to resist.
Yang Tiancheng waved his hand, "Forget it, since there is no way to change the outcome, there is no need to increase casualties by resisting. My Yang family is full of loyal people." After saying this, he closed his eyes. Three seconds later, blood spilled from the corner of his mouth, and he died from a self-shock. When everyone saw the head of the family like this, they also said, "My Yang family is full of loyal people." They went with the family head.
The soldiers originally thought it was a fierce battle. When they saw the scene inside the hall, they all bowed and left to search for survivors in other courtyards.
